data.long_meaning: From the Armenian name ‘Hiramont’ meaning ‘soldier, strong one’. In the Bible, Hiram is a king who assists King Solomon in building the Temple in Jerusalem. Parents who choose Armond usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier, strong one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
